author: Claude (Cloudreach Meshy generation worker), owner-authorized Meshy use (Standing owner direction 1, 15 Oct 2026)
workflow: agent-drafted multi-view concept from repo references (Meshy image-to-image nano-banana-pro) -> Meshy multi-image-to-3d (latest, quad remesh, PBR)
target_size_m: 7 x 6 m footprint, 8 m to ridge

scale_normalisation.method: lossless: GLB scene roots wrapped in node 'metres_root' with uniform scale + translation; base at y=0, footprint centred on x/z

concepts.prompt: Two-storey cliffside cottage, 7 by 6 metre footprint, 8 metres to the roof ridge. Ground floor built of rough coursed pale limestone blocks; upper floor of cream plaster with honey timber framing. Steep slate-blue tiled gable roof with a small stone chimney. Three or four deep-set windows with warm amber glowing glass panes. A small honey-timber balcony on the upper floor. Cosy fantasy village architecture matching the tower and material palette references. Stylised-realism game asset in the Palworld / Animo art style, single isolated object on a plain neutral background, even soft daylight, no cast background, no people. Materials: pale warm-grey weathered limestone (#9a8f80 to #b8ad9c, never pure white) with clearly stacked horizontal sedimentary strata and soft moss on the ledges; where present, slate-blue roof tile (#3d4a66), honey-coloured timber, cream plaster, royal-blue banner fabric with a small gold accent. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no maroon anywhere. Flat ground contact at the base.

visual_verdict: Good: stone ground floor, cream plaster/honey timber upper storey, slate-blue roof, balcony, amber windows. Footprint narrower than brief (4.7 x 5.4 m at 8 m ridge) and one roof edge has a ragged chunk. Windows share the single Meshy material (no separate pane material).
integration_flag: OFF - candidate only; stays flag-off until its scene passes code-blind judging
palette_check: no red/oxblood requested or observed; blue banners/roofs only
